(☉ㅅ☉U)|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 20 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Molten]])}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|New enemy approaching!|Beginning of Wave 20 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Molten Mode|Molten]] & [[Pre-MEGA Modes|Pre-MEGA]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Molten''' is a lava-themed [[Enemies|enemy]] that appears in [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]], [[Molten Mode|Molten]] and Molten Arena [[PVP]] modes. In Molten Arena [[PVP]], it does not appear naturally and can only be sent by a player. It also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. It has a decent amount of health and a high defense, though it has above average speed, being slightly faster than the [[Elite Abnormal]]. It also has [[Burn Immunity]], meaning it cannot be set on fire, and [[Corpse (Attribute)|Corpse]], making it leave a [[Corpse (Attribute)|Corpse]] on death. It can be spawned from the [[Mystery]] upon its death, wave 21 onwards in [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] mode only. It could also be spawned by the [[Molten Boss]], [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode only. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Modern |The current version of the '''Molten''' has orange-red skin, which is meant to be magma, covered by black molten lava. It has multiple cracks in that molten lava, exposing its body. It has two animations that are randomly chosen. |Legacy |{{Tabber |Current |The current version of the legacy '''Molten''' is similar to the third version, except it has a slash across its forehead, with drooping lines leaking from it. When the '''Molten''' walks, its head moves from side to side. |Version 3 |The third version of the '''Molten''' had glowing orange-red skin and a puddle of lava on its chest with fire emitting from its torso. Its torso and legs were black cobblestone. It also wore a metal armband on its left arm. A lava trail was left behind as it walks. It had a drooling zombie face. |Version 2 |The second version of the '''Molten''' had glowing orange-red skin and a puddle of lava on its chest with smoke being emitted from its torso. Its torso was a lighter shade of orange-red than its skin while its legs are orange. A lava trail is left behind as it walks. It has a drooling zombie face. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Molten''' had glowing orange-red skin and a puddle of lava on its chest with smoke being emitted from its torso. Its torso was a lighter shade of orange-red than its skin while its legs are orange. A lava trail is left behind as it walks. It head was block-shaped and it had a drooling zombie face. }} }} ==Strategy== *Towers with decent DPS like the [[Militant]], [[Cowboy]], [[Golden Scout]] or [[Military Base]] can mow down large hordes of '''Moltens'''. **Late-game DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]] or [[Crook Boss]] can also be used. *Splash damage towers like the [[Pursuit]], [[Mortar]] or [[Rocketeer]] can be useful here, as they most often spawn in hordes. **These towers are also capable of bypassing its [[Defense]]. *The [[Trapper]] can be quite useful at killing '''Moltens''', due to its traps bypassing [[Defense]]. *The [[Military Base]]'s [[units]] can easily soak up several collisions with '''Moltens''', due to their collision damage bypassing its [[Defense]]. *Some stalling towers like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Freezer]] or [[Sledger]] can be used to kill the '''Moltens''', slow them down and in some cases drop their defense. *While towers that deal fire damage like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Trapper]] cannot burn the '''Molten''', they can still deal non-burn damage to it. **They cannot, however, drop their defense, making their defense dropping useless against the '''Molten'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|
